name: RC-B10-0459/2025 – After § 18 – Am 7
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the polarisation and increased repression in Serbia, one year after the Novi Sad tragedy
part_text: 18a. Expresses concern about the social and environmental risks associated with the mining project in Jadar led by Rio Tinto; recalls the widespread public opposition to the project; urges the Serbian Government and the Commission to reconsider the plans for a lithium and boron mine in Jadar;
